text:
maria (prod-sre): getting a bunch of alerts — Hosted API 5xx spike and elevated p95 in us-east-1. Grafana shows increase starting ~2305129900.

incident-bot: INCIDENT AUTO-OPEN: region=us-east-1 severity=high symptom=5xx+latency affected-services=hosted-api,dedicated-pools links=https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abcd123/us-east1-latency

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered -> PD-INC-230512 (Escalation to oncall).

alex (oncall): Ack. I'm paged. Looking at live tail now. Can someone post a quick summary of customer-visible errors?

maria (prod-sre): curl responses returning 502/504 and occasional 429s. Cloud API logs show upstream STS/KMS throttles + 5xx from observability ingestion (we're seeing timeouts to third-party observability ingest endpoint). Dedicated pools experiencing queuing -> tokenization timeouts.

jamal (eng-runtime): I see repeated errors from auth provider: "503 Service Unavailable" for STS AssumeRole in us-east-1. Also our observability agent is hitting 429 rate limits from external collector in same region. Stack traces attached to internal span IDs.

alex (oncall): Timeline: first alert 2305129901, volume increases till now. Rolling error rate ~18% 5xx for Hosted API 10-minute window. Dedicated pooled jobs: 12% increase in latency >2s.

kevin (platform): AWS status page shows elevated API error rates in us-east-1 for STS and ELB. https://status.aws.amazon.com/ — cross-checking.

olivia (customer-success): Heads up — two mid-market customers (acme-inc, fastchat) reported errors to support. Tanya, can you gather impacted request IDs?

tanya (support): on it. Pulling example request ids and customer-facing traces now. Will post redacted logs.

jamal (eng-runtime): Immediate mitigation proposals: 1) Route new Hosted API traffic to us-west-2 (region failover) for non-region-locked requests. 2) For Dedicated pools in us-east-1, enable local model variant fallback and increase queue workers by +20% (if capacity allows). 3) Disable expensive observability ingest path for the affected hosts to remove dependency.

maria (prod-sre): Agreed. Prioritize 1+3 (failover + disable external obs writes). 2 is riskier (scaling pools could amplify degraded nodes) — do controlled increases.

alex (oncall): I'm initiating routing policy: updating smart-router to divert 40% of new sessions to us-west-2 for non-regional accounts. Command: 
```
# pseudo
routerctl set-policy --region us-east-1 --fallback us-west-2 --pct 40 --reason "aws-us-east-1 thirdparty degradation"
```

incident-bot: Router policy change submitted (job id rtr-230512-01), rolling in 30s.

jamal (eng-runtime): Toggling observability sink to buffer-only for us-east-1 nodes. This will drop external POSTs but keep local spans for later backfill. Patching now.

kevin (platform): I'm disabling cross-account STS calls from lower-priority background jobs to reduce pressure on STS. Applying a deny policy on ephemeral workers.

maria (prod-sre): Quick customer-impact calc: 18% 5xx on hosted for last 10m; approx 4% of total unique API keys saw >=1 failure; 3 customers have >50 failing requests. Noting SLA exposure for 2 enterprise customers.

olivia (customer-success): Notifying impacted customers with a brief: "We are investigating elevated errors in us-east-1; temporary mitigation includes regional routing. Full RCA to follow." Sent to acme-inc and fastchat.

tanya (support): Posted sample request ids and trace links in #support-escalations.

alex (oncall): Monitoring metrics after router change. Early signal: overall 5xx rate down to ~12% in 2min. Latency p95 for Hosted API in us-east-1 still elevated but improving.

jamal (eng-runtime): Observability sink disabled; external 429s stop and our internal queue drains. That appears to free CPU on the telemetry threads — latency a bit better.

maria (prod-sre): Can we run a controlled sweep for Dedicated pools: add 2 workers to each affected node (staggered) and monitor CPU/queue? Jamal to coordinate.

jamal (eng-runtime): Starting staggered worker bump now (node set A -> +2, wait 45s, node set B -> +2). Logs: 
```
[OK] node-a1 workers=+2
[OK] node-b3 workers=+2
```

alex (oncall): After worker bump we see throughput recover without immediate failures. Keep an eye for retry storms.

kevin (platform): AWS console shows STS errors trending down slightly — looks like global control plane is partially recovered. But ELB health checks are still flapping for some autoscaling groups in us-east-1.

maria (prod-sre): Decision: keep router diversion at 40% for next 20m, keep obs sink disabled until stable, continue controlled worker bumps. If 5xx <5% and p95 < 800ms we start step-down.

olivia (customer-success): Updating customers: included mitigation steps and ETA for next update in 30m.

tanya (support): Support ticket INC-230512 created and linked to PD-INC-230512. Triage notes added.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-230512 acknowledged by alex. Assigned to oncall and eng-runtime.

maria (prod-sre): Note for post-incident: evaluate dependency isolation for auth/obs providers, consider local caching for STS tokens, and add fallback for observability path to prevent cascading CPU load.

jamal (eng-runtime): Logging commands used during investigation: 
```
# check 5xx by region
curl -s "https://internal-api.redwood/metrics?region=us-east-1&metric=5xx" | jq .
# tail logs
kubectl logs -n prod -l app=hosted-api --since=5m | grep "502\|504\|STS"
```

alex (oncall): Current status: partial mitigation in place, monitoring. If we see recurrence or sustained >10% 5xx we'll escalate to SEV. For now lowering page noise but keep PD channel open.

maria (prod-sre): assigning action owners:
- Jamal: document exact router changes and worker steps (post to incident doc)
- Kevin: audit STS usage by background jobs and implement throttling/backoff
- Tanya/Olivia: customer comms + impacted accounts list
- Alex: watch metrics and landstep rollback criteria

olivia (customer-success): Noted. Will prepare a short postmortem template for customer distribution once RCA is ready.

maria (prod-sre): Closing immediate pager for now. We'll keep this thread open and update incident tracker with timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation actions applied. Monitoring.

alex (oncall): Last note: no data loss expected; most affected requests failed with 5xx and will be retried by clients. Keeping alert level at "investigating" until next update.

-- thread continues in incident doc: https://incidents.internal/INC-230512 --
